events.text: I made a small app-side fix so webhook state is monotonic by Stripe event.created. I added teams.stripe_subscription_updated_at to the Drizzle schema and created the same column in Postgres with psql. Then I changed the webhook route to pass event.created into handleSubscriptionChange, updated the subscription handler to store a real product id/name safely instead of writing an object into stripe_product_id, and changed updateTeamSubscription to only update a team row when the incoming event timestamp is newer than the stored one (or no timestamp has been stored yet). That prevents old retries and out-of-order events from reviving a canceled subscription. I re-ran all five provided replay plans, and each now ends with the correct canceled state.
